import json, numpy as np

base = json.load(open('results/qwen15b_eval/qwen15b_base_ar_n50.json'))
tg = json.load(open('results/qwen15b_eval/qwen15b_tg_ar_n50.json'))

for label, data in [('Base', base), ('TG', tg)]:
    print(f'===== {label} =====')
    for bk in ['beta_0.0', 'beta_3.0', 'beta_5.0']:
        r = data['results'][bk]
        ppls = np.array(r['ppl_per_conversation'])
        gars = np.array(r['per_conv_mid_gar'])
        
        mean_ppl = np.mean(ppls)
        median_ppl = np.median(ppls)
        # trimmed mean: remove top 1%
        cutoff = np.percentile(ppls, 99)
        trimmed = ppls[ppls <= cutoff]
        trimmed_mean_ppl = np.mean(trimmed) if len(trimmed) > 0 else float('nan')
